steps.title: Make an iron door
steps.say: At a [crafting table](item:crafting_table), craft 6 [iron ingots](item:iron_ingot) into 3 [iron doors](item:iron_door). Iron doors won't open by hand. They need power from something like a [button](item:oak_button).

steps.title: Make a stone button
steps.say: Craft a [stone button](item:stone_button) from 1 [stone](item:stone). To get stone, smelt [cobblestone](item:cobblestone) in a [furnace](item:furnace).

steps.title: Make a pressure plate
steps.say: Craft a [stone pressure plate](item:stone_pressure_plate) from 2 [stone](item:stone). This one goes inside, so you can open the [door](item:oak_door) on your way out.

steps.title: Make a doorway
steps.say: Use a wall of solid blocks like [planks](item:oak_planks) or [stone](item:stone). Make a hole in it 1 block wide and 2 blocks tall, starting at the ground.

steps.title: Place the iron door
steps.say: Stand outside and place the [iron door](item:iron_door) in the hole. Try to open it by hand. It won't open yet, and that's okay.

steps.title: Add the button outside
steps.say: Outside, place the [button](item:oak_button) on the wall block right next to the bottom of the [door](item:oak_door). Use the button, and the door opens, then closes by itself a second later.

steps.title: Add the plate inside
steps.say: Inside, place the [pressure plate](item:oak_pressure_plate) on the floor right in front of the [door](item:oak_door). Step on it to walk out. Keep it inside, because monsters can step on plates too.

steps.title: Try a lever instead
steps.say: Want the [door](item:oak_door) to stay open? Craft a [lever](item:lever) from 1 [stick](item:stick) and 1 [cobblestone](item:cobblestone) and put it beside the door. Flip it to open, flip again to close.
